hotspots.title: Manuel Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Judicial authorities in Argentina are intensifying their investigation into Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni for alleged illicit enrichment. Multiple articles detail forensic analysis of a contractor’s phone, asset inconsistencies, and pending sworn declarations, with fiscal scrutiny of cryptocurrency transactions and undeclared assets.
hotspots.affect: The scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its moral charge, polarized contention between government allies and opposition, and the high-profile nature of Adorni’s role in President Milei’s administration.

hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition deals reshape Spanish regional governments
hotspots.blurb: Spain’s conservative PP and far-right Vox have formalized coalition agreements in Castilla y León, Aragón, and Extremadura, adopting Vox’s ‘national priority’ policies. The deals have sparked backlash over anti-immigration measures, budget reallocations, and ideological concessions, with negotiations ongoing in Andalusia.
hotspots.affect: The hotspot is charged due to the ideological polarization, moral panic over immigration policies, and the high stakes of far-right influence in regional governance.
